question: Does an independently checked exhaustive reachable-set certificate prove the six-site infeasible patterns, and what is the exact capacity-matched observable ceiling for WSP20's frozen workload?
hypothesis: Independent producer/checker agree on the full six-site reachable response domain. Patterns absent from a completely checked closure may be called infeasible under this exact architecture, not generally unlearnable. Compare the resulting protected observable upper bound with the unchanged WSP20 control; equality certifies finite-workload capacity saturation, a gap quantifies residual search loss. No predetermined optimum or improvement is assumed.

frozen_design.source: Unchanged WSP22 parent and unchanged WSP15 strict learner/WSP20 result-first-packed.json. Observed contexts[0,1,2,4,7,3]. No hidden labels.
frozen_design.capacity: Exactly3 raw inputs,<=6 ordered feedforward NAND sites,75 canonical binary synaptic scalars. Empty incoming rows only in allow_disconnected. Output must connect to raw or gate, never a free null source.
frozen_design.producer: Construct all response-set layers0..6 using packed six-observation Boolean integers and NAND. Every candidate output is included before duplicate-gate pruning. Store exact sorted response-set frontiers, complete output sets per depth and constructive SAT witnesses from unchanged WSP22 for every reachable response.
frozen_design.independent_checker: Decode proof into tuples of six Boolean outcomes. Independently generate all unordered source-pair NAND successors componentwise for EVERY state of each preceding layer. Require exact equality of each claimed next frontier and all claimed reachable outputs, with fixed raw-only initial outputs and optional zero INPUT. Reject missing/extra states/outputs and malformed proofs. Do not call the producer or packed NAND arithmetic. Witnesses for the full reachable set are separately checked with original numeric execution and independent graph interpretation.
frozen_design.soundness: Merging states with identical available six-observation response functions preserves all possible future observed functions. A gate duplicating an available function may be bypassed for future input uses, so it cannot improve a <=6-site observed computation; its current output is still recorded. This finite observational quotient proves capacity only on the six fixed observed inputs, never hidden truth or every full8-input truth mask.
frozen_design.budgets: Per mode max500000 stored states and10000000 attempted producer transitions, depth6. Independent checker must complete full closure within same state/transition bounds and30minute hosted timeout. A cap/timeout is UNRESOLVED, never infeasibility. No parameter or bound changes after outcomes.
frozen_design.workload_ceiling: Reconstruct all32 original five-label signatures x seeds17,29,43,71 through unchanged WSP15 strict1024 proposals. Add the identical WSP20 contradiction witness opposite initial context3 output. Compute the5-bit original-valid protection mask. Over ALL certified reachable six-label responses satisfying that mask, find the maximum observable accuracy for each of128 tasks. Sum exact maxima and compare with saved WSP20 single_protected score (742/768), while checking saved initial-old-valid count472. Never pass an oracle solution back into the learner.
frozen_design.controls: Reject corrupted or incomplete closure proofs, extra outputs, fake free-null output at depth0, wrong depth/capacity, forward wires and changed parent identities. Independent brute wiring check at depth<=2. All checked SAT witnesses must cold-restore. Parent22 miss labels remain UNRESOLVED in that original experiment; this is a new independent proof gate, not retrospective threshold tuning.
frozen_design.hypotheses_not_tested: No new training method, transfer, efficiency, native primitive invention or intelligence superiority. Conventional/symbolic larger-capacity results stay intact; this diagnoses their capacity mismatch rather than manufacturing a new learning win.

metrics: exact protected ceiling per task and total
task count whose target is infeasible

classification_rules.capacity_proved: Complete independently checked closure and independent SAT witness coverage; absent responses then infeasible only under exact finite rules
classification_rules.capacity_saturation: Saved control score equals summed verified protected ceiling; no new learned gain claimed
classification_rules.residual_search_gap: Saved control score below summed exact ceiling
classification_rules.unresolved: Any proof/custody/cap/timeout failure; no infeasibility claim
classification_rules.scientific_superiority: None; formal finite-domain capacity diagnostic, not independent learning acceptance

qualification: Remote prereg before implementation/primary, independent negative controls, repository result/provenance/proof. Final exact SHA/tree all original+WSP01-17+WSP19-23 tests, full proof/ceiling evaluator, permanent G29 and clean source on hosted Ubuntu/Windows2022. Reuse the existing read-only workflow. No merge/admission/deployment or private runner.
